children: Xenetic Biosciences signed a Share Exchange Agreement to acquire Santersus in an all-stock transaction intended to be tax-free. At closing, Santersus shareholders will receive Xenetic common stock based on a defined exchange ratio, and Santersus options will be assumed. Concurrently, Xenetic investors holding about 9% entered voting agreements to support the deal, and insiders of both companies agreed to 180-day post-closing lock-ups. The combined company plans to be named Santersus Bio and remain listed on Nasdaq, with Santersus holders expected to own roughly 85% on a fully diluted basis, subject to adjustments.
